items.description: ANS-176 — Gitblit near-idle when idle: "Find what it spends the CPU on (Lucene indexing, a ticket or federation poll, a GC loop, the MCP server's queries) and bring it down to near-idle." Settled bar: after the run's push has rolled the pod, gitblit-app averages at most 50m CPU over an hour, read from Prometheus (`http://prometheus.home`, `rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{namespace="git-sync-prd",container="gitblit-app"}[...])`); the hour is one in which a single gitblit pod (the one the push rolled) runs throughout — no second roll inside it — and which does not overlap the 02:00–03:00 Europe/Amsterdam git-sync and the re-index after it; before the fix it ran ≈ 500–600m, and ≈ 200m even in a pre-fix pod's first hours.
items.rationale: Pod gitblit-5478ff97cf-xlzd2 (rolled 15:28 by the operator's follow-up push 29395a0, which contains 4489edc) ran 15:28-16:34 CEST, single pod, outside 02-03h; Prometheus rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{container=gitblit-app}[5m]) 5m samples 7-21m, mean ~12m, far under 50m. The earlier pod gitblit-846d6b6cc5-q5fq2 (14:37-15:28 on 4489edc) ran 6-22m. Pre-fix 500-600m.

items.description: The running gitblit-app JVM has explicit GC disabled (`-XX:+DisableExplicitGC`) and still runs with a 1024M heap maximum — shown by the live pod and the JVM's own command line/startup, not only by the rendered chart. Today the container sets no `JAVA_OPTS` (GitSyncDeploy `chart/templates/gitblit-deployment.yaml:72-73`, commented out).
items.rationale: kubectl exec into live gitblit-app, /proc cmdline: `java -server -Xmx1024M -XX:+DisableExplicitGC ...` (both pods); chart sets JAVA_OPTS in gitblit-deployment.yaml:75-76.

items.description: gitblit-app has no CPU request in prd; its `memory: 4096Mi` request is unchanged, and no other container's resources changed (today `config/prd/values.yaml:35-38` requests `cpu: 600m`, `memory: 4096Mi`).
items.rationale: Live deployment resources: gitblit-app requests {memory:4Gi} no cpu; 4489edc diff on config/prd/values.yaml only removes `cpu: 600m`. Later operator commit 29395a0 (ANS-206) also dropped other CPU requests and retuned mcp/nginx memory; gitblit-app memory still 4Gi.
evidence: kubectl get deploy gitblit; git show 4489edc

items.description: The run pushed the change to GitSyncDeploy `main`; Argo CD Application `argocd-prd/git-sync-prd` is Synced and Healthy on that commit, and the new gitblit pod is Ready with all three containers running and no restarts across the observation hour.
items.rationale: Pushed 4489edc to GitSyncDeploy main; Argo CD git-sync-prd Synced+Healthy on it (pod 3/3 Running 97s later), later on descendant 29395a0 Synced/Healthy. Restarts 0 for both pods across the observation; the roll at 15:28 was a new commit, not a restart.
